course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: The mark distribution of 120 students of the course CSE 3207’ has a mean of 70 and a (13) standard deviation of 15. If a sample of 25 students are selected randomly then i) What is the probability that the sample mean is between 65 and 72?
ii) Estimate the value that is two standard deviation above the expected value, 70, of the sample mean.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
